description: Lignes de bus du périmètre de la Communauté urbaine de Dunkerque is a dataset listed in Open Data Dunkerque Agglomération, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Communauté urbaine de Dunkerque. Ce jeu de données est lié à la visualisation suivante: Visualisation - Lignes de bus du périmètre de la Communauté urbaine de Dunkerque Ensemble du réseau de bus sur le périmètre de la communauté Urbaine de Dunkerque mis en place en septembre 2018. Coverage: Dunkirk urban community. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are bus, transport, mobilité. The portal shows 21 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-dunkerque-agglo-fr-portal.
